evals.prompt: Create a new widget called holiday-promo with high priority
evals.expected_output: The skill classifies the intent as create/widget, loads the domain guide and template, customizes the template with the provided name and priority, previews the configuration, and creates the object via the API.
expectations: The skill reads references/domain-guide.md to understand constraints
The skill reads prompts/1-intent-classification.txt to classify user intent
The skill reads templates/example-template.json for the object template
The skill presents the customized configuration for user review before creating
The skill calls api_request to create the object only after user confirmation

evals.prompt: Find all active widgets related to campaigns
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the search script to discover matching objects and presents the results in a formatted table.
expectations: The skill runs scripts/example_query.py with --action search and a relevant --query
The skill presents results in a readable table format
The skill does not attempt to create or modify any objects

evals.prompt: What types of objects can I create?
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the domain guide and explains the available object types, their required fields, and constraints.
expectations: The skill explains widget and widget-group object types
The skill mentions required fields and constraints
The skill does not call any APIs or scripts
